name: Please Be Quiet Xi'an 2025

organisers.name: Xi'an Cube Association (西安魔方协会)

information:
Please check the competition website for registration, schedule, etc.

This competition limits the number of registrations by event:
3x3x3 Blindfolded: 30
4x4x4 Blindfolded: 15
5x5x5 Blindfolded: 15
3x3x3 Multi-Blind: 15
Each event will be based on first-come-first-served basis according to the order of registration, and 75 competitors will be the theoretical maximum of the number of registrations.
